overall.summary: The new calculation can be switched on for every request at once, with no scoped rollout, failure containment, or evidence for the activated path.

observations.title: All-at-once pricing cutover
observations.principle: High-impact behavior changes should constrain blast radius and preserve a dependable rollback path.
observations.summary: One process-wide mutable flag routes every quote to the new calculator immediately.
observations.impact: A defect changes prices for the full process population, and calculator failures have no local fallback to the established behavior.
observations.recommendation: Introduce the new path behind a scoped rollout decision and define failure handling that can return traffic to the legacy calculation quickly.
observations.tradeoffs: A cohort or tenant-aware decision adds rollout machinery, but pricing correctness justifies that cost and the old implementation already provides a natural fallback.

evidence.detail: The feature decision is a process-wide static value.
Every quote takes the new path when the single flag is true.
The new calculation has no failure containment or fallback.

observations.title: Unvalidated activated pricing path
observations.principle: The highest-risk branch of a behavior change needs direct validation before it can be activated.
observations.summary: The included test covers only the legacy quote while the new calculator becomes runtime-selectable.
observations.impact: The cutover can be deployed without evidence that the new result or its failure behavior is correct.
observations.recommendation: Validate representative new-pricing results and failure behavior through the same quote boundary used in production.
observations.tradeoffs: Focused boundary scenarios are sufficient for this change; a detailed testing strategy belongs in a specialist review.

evidence.detail: The only scenario asserts legacy subtotal behavior.
quote now contains a runtime-selectable new branch.

strengths.summary: The legacy calculation remains available as an explicit implementation path.

evidence.detail: The existing behavior is retained behind legacyQuote.
